# Phase Two — Specific Candidate File Plan

The Awtsmoos gives every module its border and every border a reason to remain.
Awtsmoos.com should change only the vessels whose responsibility actually carries the strain.

## Candidate Production Files

This is a candidate map, not final approval. Phase Three may remove files after deeper critique.

### 1. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/index.html`

Potential full rewrite because the DOM currently presents hero, scope navigation, results, and discovery rail as peer regions. Preserve every required ID consumed by `searchDom.js`: `searchForm`, `query`, `series`, `searchMode`, `book`, `corpus`, `laneField`, `bookField`, `corpusField`, `status`, `results`, `laneDirectory`, `laneCount`, `recentSearches`, `historyFilter`, `clearHistory`.

Keep existing script/module URLs unless inspection proves a stale reference. Preserve the actual browser route `/mawgawl/sefarim/`.

### 2. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/hero.css`

Potential full rewrite to turn the billboard hero into a compact identity masthead. Preserve semantic identity and source-truth copy while reducing vertical and decorative weight.

### 3. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/layout.css`

Potential full rewrite to establish a results-first reading column and demote permanent discovery-rail width. Keep status/error/empty ownership here only if those rules remain cohesive and the file stays under 120 lines.

### 4. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/discovery.css`

Potential full rewrite to make lanes/history/help tertiary context rather than equal-weight permanent panels.

### 5. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/responsive.css`

Potential full rewrite to ensure tablet and short-height transitions match the new hierarchy, not the old two-column rail assumptions.

### 6. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/mobile-context.css`

Potential full rewrite because its current 86vw horizontal card carousel keeps tertiary context visually large and swipe-dependent.

### 7. `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/mobile.css`

Potential full rewrite only if selectors/order must change to support the new compact masthead/context flow. Preserve safe-area handling, 16px control text inherited from form.css, horizontal scope safety, and result readability.

- `SearchApp.js`
- `SearchControlDisclosure.js`

- `SearchIntentController.js`

## Read-Before-Final-Plan Owners

- `styles/hero.css`
- `styles/shell.css`

These reads decide whether the final write set can shrink further.

## Dirty Families — Explicit Non-Mutation Boundary

No production writes in this wave to:

- `geelooy/games/shema-strike/**`
- `geelooy/games/ohrfront/**`
- `geelooy/social-composer/**`
- `geelooy/apps/animator/**`
- `geelooy/games/mitzvahWorld/**`
- `scripts/runtime_quality/**`

They remain audit targets while active owners work.

## First-Draft Order

1. Refresh scoped Git status.
2. Rewrite all approved source files in one coherent implementation pass, complete-file only.
3. Read every rewritten file back in full.
4. Only then run tests and browser verification.
5. Write planned-vs-actual delta.
6. If delta exists, perform a second complete-file implementation pass and reread everything.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the remaining visual owners, then perform Phase Three with at least thirty *additional* improvements and write the final brainstorm plus exact execution file list.
